body: Migrate(ctx) creates the tables, but there is no record of which schema version a database is at, so a later column or index change has no safe upgrade path. Add a ledger table (version, applied_at), numbered migrations applied in order inside a transaction where the engine allows it, and a refusal to start against a database newer than the code. Note: sqlb contrib/migrate is unimportable until sqlb is tagged.
title: sqlstore: schema versioning and a migration ledger
